title: Running Club Miles Guest Return Rate
dataSources: Club attendance (`club:attendance`), running-club sessions (`runningclub:session`), maker-space visits (`makerspace:visit`), book-club meetings (`bookclub:meeting`), community events (`community:event`).
app: Book-club attendance, running-club miles, maker-space visits, and general social-club participation logs streamed to Splunk HEC via forms, check-ins, and calendar exports.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=runningclub:session
| stats sum(eval(if(guest_visit="yes",1,0))) as guest_visits sum(eval(if(returned_after_guest="yes",1,0))) as returned_guests by route_name
| eval return_rate=round(100*returned_guests/guest_visits,1)
| sort - return_rate
description: Measures how often first-time or guest visits to running club miles turn into a return visit.
value: Return rate is a simple health metric for social groups because it captures whether the experience feels welcoming enough to repeat.
implementation: Capture a guest flag and a return flag during event logging or member check-in.
visualization: Table of route values by guest return rate.
grandmaExplanation: It highlights which kinds of running club miles make newcomers want to come back.
